description: Generate DJ names — 'DJ' + word combos in styles like Neon, Thunder, and Cosmic.

faqs.a: Classic (DJ + word), Neon (glowing words), Thunder (powerful words), Cosmic (space words), and Wildcard (anything goes).
8 names per click, all unique in the batch.
Click any name to copy it.
faqs.q: How do I copy a name?

howto: Click any name to copy it.
title: DJ Name Generator
